Do not submit this issue.

Security vulnerabilities, credentials, and affected-user information must not be reported publicly. Close this draft without adding details, read `SECURITY.md`, and privately contact the repository owner through the approved GitHub security-advisory channel. Do not send passwords, API keys, private access tokens, bookmaker login credentials, full payment-card data, identity documents, or unnecessary personal data.
